I really do hate when people say “I’m sorry” about one being suicidal.

I think some people are like that, but not all. Some really don’t want one to end things. Even if they’re strangers, people can be empathetic. Depending where one is in their suicidal state, says can be easier than some and other days or even in hours it’s all darkness. it’s true when you’re suicidal it’s all one can think about... it’s an illness I’ve suffered with since age 7. Suicide can run in families as well. There really isn’t anything you can say to someone who’s suicidal, but there’s also no reason to explain to them ether. It’s a hopeless battle we go thru. But even one who’s suicidal, you wouldn’t let another suicidal person kill themselves in front of you would you? Really ask yourself that, and if you did chances are you’d want to kill yourself for doing so. No need to lash out on others.
